name: triage
description: Drag items onto an impact/effort plane — the whole layout comes back as one action when the human sends it

x_label.description: Horizontal axis, low on the left

y_label.description: Vertical axis, high at the top

quadrants.description: Corner labels, clockwise from top-left: high-y/low-x, high-y/high-x, low-y/low-x, low-y/high-x

items.description: Chips: [{ id, label, meta }] or plain strings

tour_step.description: Tour only: the step indicator, e.g. "2 of 7". Empty hides the tour rail.

tour_next.description: Tour only: label for the advance button

tour_id.description: Tour only: which step this is, echoed back on the next action
